limits: Source occurrence does not establish a unique normative spelling, a preferred Roman input, measured frequency, or absence of a Nepali equivalent.
Source-assisted implementation authorization is separate from independent human linguistic review.
A normalized complete key uses the dictionary; unlisted spellings and attached forms such as camerako retain the existing phonetic fallback.
Reserved T/D/S/R and contextual H behavior is preserved; no blanket lowercasing or new cased aliases are authorized.
Whole-field English exclusion and disabled conversion work; URLs, code, addresses and English spans inside a Nepali field are not automatically protected.
Only source metadata and observations are redistributed here; no raw source datasets or bulk source text are included.
